penalties.details: On January 16, Food safety Officer (FSO), Jaipur has picked up a sample of Sundrop Oil and sent it for analysis. The Food Analysis after testing the product declared it as 'misbranded', since the product is having a line 'Healty Oil for Healty People'. Subsequently, the FSO has filed a complaint before the 'Adjudicating Officer and Additional District Magistrate, Jaipur'. In January 2023, the Adjudicating Officer and Additional District Magistrate had decided the complaint and imposed a penalty of INR 50,000 on the Comapny. Subsequently, the Company had filed an appeal against the said order before Food Safety Appellate Tribunal (FSAT), Jaipur. In September 2026, FSAT, Jaipur has dismissed the appeal filed by the Company through its order dated 03.09.2026.
penalties.impact: The Company is preparing to file the appeal against the order dated 10-09-2026 before High Court of Rajasthan. There is no other impact on the financials or operations of the Company.

timeline.summary: Sundrop Brands Limited (formerly Agro Tech Foods) will hold an Investor/Analyst Conference Call on May 08, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST to discuss Q4 & FY2026 audited financial results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹386.55 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹10.2 Cr (against a loss of ₹114.46 Cr a year earlier).
Sundrop Brands Limited announced the audio recording of its Investors/Analysts Conference Call on 08 May 2026 at 12:00 PM IST, discussing FY2026 audited results, available at the company’s website.
Sundrop Brands held its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call on May 8, 2026, discussing integration milestones, core category momentum, and margin expansion targets.
CAG-TECH (MAURITIUS) LIMITED, promoter of Sundrop Brands Limited, disclosed holding 14,666,522 equity shares as of March 31, 2026, with no new encumbrances.
Sundrop Brands promoter CAG-Tech (Mauritius) submitted its annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming no new encumbrances on its 1.47 crore shares.
Sundrop Brands Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on 07 August 2026, reporting 15% YoY revenue growth to ₹428.08 Cr with stable 7% EBITDA margin
Sundrop Brands Limited will hold an Investors/Analysts Conference call on November 06, 2026 from 11:00am to 12:00pm IST.
